entities.name: Shapeshifters
entities.description: A loosely defined group of beings capable of assuming other shapes and forms, often imitating other beings.

entities.name: Shrouds
entities.description: Membrane creatures of Nohrland's mountains in Cridhe, accidentally created by Malvos and Crephas, which disguise themselves as fabric and dissolve travelers.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Created the shrouds with Crephas while trying to make an invisible cloak.

entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: Created the shrouds with Malvos while trying to make an invisible cloak.

entities.name: Changelings
entities.description: Lorwyn's harmless, semi-intelligent shapeshifters who involuntarily take the shape of nearby creatures and plants.

entities.name: Mimics
entities.description: Shadowmoor's aggressive changelings that attack in packs.

entities.name: Pucas
entities.description: Horse-headed shapeshifters active only in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Firdoch
entities.description: Animated standing stones serving Eirdu and Isilu, managing the boundaries between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Lupuls
entities.description: Ravnican shapeshifters that follow the vampire Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Vampire commanding the lupuls until Jarad disrupted his control.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Devkarin hunter who communicated with and disrupted Szadek's control of the lupuls.

entities.name: Gladewalkers
entities.description: Green-aligned Kaldheim shapeshifters that prefer wild beast forms.

entities.name: Covewalkers
entities.description: Blue-aligned Kaldheim shapeshifters fascinated with water.

entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: The Kaldheim realm where shapeshifters live.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Phyrexian whose experiments on Rath bore results that took after their master.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Her downfall left changelings remaining in Lorwyn.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: A mysterious cavern where changelings convene each year and new changelings are created.

events.summary: Malvos and Crephas, trying to make an invisible cloak, accidentally create the shrouds.
events.quote: Attempting to create an invisible cloak, Malvos and Crephas combined a patch of lint from a Haenish cloak

events.summary: After Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless driven into Shadowmoor.
events.quote: Since Oona's downfall, changelings remain in Lorwyn unless they are driven into Shadowmoor unwillingly.

events.summary: The lupuls, thought defeated centuries earlier, resurface under Szadek until Jarad disrupts his control.
events.quote: they resurfaced under Szadek 's command, until his control was disrupted by Jarad .
